title: Anya Finds Balance
moral: Balancing screen time with other activities keeps you healthy and happy.

scenes.summary: Anya enjoys playing on her tablet but spends too much time on it.
scenes.text:
Anya and the Too-Much Screen Time

In a bright little house, lived a cheerful girl named Anya.

Anya loved playing games on her tablet.

She played in the morning…

In the afternoon…

And even at night.

But there was one problem…

Anya spent too much time on screens.
scenes.image_prompt: young girl using tablet indoors for long time, colorful cartoon home scene

scenes.summary: Anya ignores other activities and spends all her time on screens.
scenes.text:
“Come play outside!” called her brother Rohan.

“Just a minute,” Anya said.

But that “minute” became hours.

She missed playing in the park.

She skipped drawing time.

She even forgot her homework once!
scenes.image_prompt: girl ignoring brother while using tablet indoors, playful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Anya begins to feel tired and unwell due to too much screen time.
scenes.text:
One day, Anya felt very tired.

Her eyes hurt.

Her head felt heavy.

“This isn’t fun anymore,” she said.
scenes.image_prompt: tired girl rubbing eyes after screen use, soft cartoon style

scenes.summary: Her mother advises her to balance her time and create a routine.
scenes.text:
Her mother sat beside her.

“Too much screen time isn’t good,” she said kindly.

“You need balance.”

Anya looked down.

“I didn’t realize,” she said.

“Let’s make a routine,” her mother said.

“Screen time, play time, and study time.”

Anya nodded.

“I’ll try!”
scenes.image_prompt: mother talking gently to child about screen time, warm home cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Anya balances her activities and feels happier and healthier.
scenes.text:
The next day, Anya played outside with Rohan.

She drew pictures.

She finished her homework.

Then she used her tablet for a short time.

“I feel much better!” she said.

Balance your time.

Too much of anything is not good.

The End
scenes.image_prompt: happy girl playing outside then studying and using tablet briefly, cheerful cartoon

story:
Anya and the Too-Much Screen Time

In a bright little house, lived a cheerful girl named Anya.

Anya loved playing games on her tablet.

She played in the morning…

In the afternoon…

And even at night.

But there was one problem…

Anya spent too much time on screens.

“Come play outside!” called her brother Rohan.

“Just a minute,” Anya said.

But that “minute” became hours.

She missed playing in the park.

She skipped drawing time.

She even forgot her homework once!

One day, Anya felt very tired.

Her eyes hurt.

Her head felt heavy.

“This isn’t fun anymore,” she said.

Her mother sat beside her.

“Too much screen time isn’t good,” she said kindly.

“You need balance.”

Anya looked down.

“I didn’t realize,” she said.

“Let’s make a routine,” her mother said.

“Screen time, play time, and study time.”

Anya nodded.

“I’ll try!”

The next day, Anya played outside with Rohan.

She drew pictures.

She finished her homework.

Then she used her tablet for a short time.

“I feel much better!” she said.

Balance your time.

Too much of anything is not good.

The End
